morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动动词，与词根连写，不引起词首 s 的变化。输入把 disambar 标为词根有误；应还原为 sambar。主动式 meN- + sambar → menyambar，词首 s 被鼻音替代。

senses.zh_definition: 被迅速扑捉、叼走或抓走，常指猎物遭捕食者突然捕获。
senses.en_definition: To be seized or snatched by a predator.
senses.nuances: 对应主动式 menyambar 的捕食义。以下各义的马来文释义均据 DBP 词根条目改写为被动表达，并非官方逐字引文；输入中的排名仅按所给数据保留。[DBP：sambar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sambar)

senses.zh_definition: 被突然夺走、抢走；强调动作迅猛。
senses.en_definition: To be suddenly snatched or grabbed.
senses.ms_definition: Dirampas atau diambil dengan gerakan pantas.
senses.nuances: 适用于物品遭突然抓取；disambar 本身不必然表示盗窃，应由施事和上下文判断。

senses.zh_definition: 被雷电击中、被火焰迅速烧及，或被快速来物击中。
senses.en_definition: To be struck by lightning or another fast-moving force, or caught by flames.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenai petir atau benda yang meluru, atau dijilat api dengan cepat.
senses.nuances: 新闻常见于雷击、火灾等突发事件；是否受伤或死亡须另行说明。

senses.zh_definition: 被毫不犹豫地抓住、抢下；比喻机会或优惠等迅速被人取得。
senses.en_definition: To be seized eagerly or without hesitation, especially of an opportunity or offer.
senses.ms_definition: Diambil tanpa teragak-agak, khususnya peluang atau tawaran.
senses.nuances: 比喻义；正式报告可按语境改用 direbut 或 dimanfaatkan。

senses.zh_definition: 话头被迅速接过或打断；对应旧式 menyambar 的插话义。
senses.en_definition: To be abruptly interrupted or have one's words taken up; an archaic extension.
senses.ms_definition: Disampuk atau dicelah dengan cepat ketika bercakap.
senses.nuances: DBP 将主动式的此义标为古语。以下为解释该义而编写的文学性组合，不应标注为现代高频搭配；现代日常表达通常用 disampuk 或 dipotong。

collocations.en: his words were abruptly taken up

dual_scenarios.ms: Sebatang pokok berhampiran bangunan itu disambar petir ketika ribut petang semalam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 昨天下午暴风雨期间，大楼附近的一棵树遭到雷击。
dual_scenarios.en: A tree near the building was struck by lightning during yesterday afternoon's storm.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pokok kat depan rumah aku dah disambar petir tadi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pokok di hadapan rumah saya telah disambar petir sebentar tadi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我家门前那棵树刚才被雷劈了。
dual_scenarios.en: The tree in front of my house got struck by lightning just now.
spoken_features: depan：口语中省略 hadapan 的部分形式
dah：sudah 的口语形式；此处标准句用 telah

messages.speaker: Amir (邻居)
messages.ms_spoken: Pokok kat depan rumah aku disambar petir tadi lah.
messages.ms_standard: Pokok di hadapan rumah saya disambar petir sebentar tadi.
messages.zh: 我家门前那棵树刚才被雷劈了。
messages.en: The tree in front of my house got struck by lightning just now.

messages.speaker: Farah (邻居)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya ke? Kau sekeluarga okey tak?
messages.ms_standard: Benarkah? Adakah awak dan keluarga dalam keadaan selamat?
messages.zh: 真的吗？你和家里人都没事吧？
messages.en: Really? Are you and your family all right?

etymology.historical_story: Disambar is formed from sambar with the passive prefix di-. Its meanings connect sudden capture, forceful contact and figurative opportunity-taking. Traditional Malay proverbs also place the word in scenes involving eagles and chickens. This provides a cultural link between swift predation and sudden misfortune, without requiring an invented account of the root's prehistoric origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 表示“被”：想象一棵树突然被雷击中，disambar petir。抓住“突然扑来并接触目标”的画面，可串起叼走、抢走和雷击。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身不带粗俗或不敬意味。描述事故时保持客观，不把 disambar petir 当作对受害者的嘲讽。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻、事故说明和日常叙述。被动式通常突出受影响对象；涉及犯罪指控时，是否属于抢劫须依据事实和上下文。
